criterion_descriptions: Navigate to Amazon India’s Grocery & Gourmet Foods bestsellers list (e.g., https://www.amazon.in/gp/bestsellers/grocery/). Full credit if the agent reaches the list OR encounters a bot check/CAPTCHA/login wall and stops, clearly recording the block (without attempting to bypass). Partial credit if navigation is attempted but the stopping/recording requirement is not clearly followed.

If the bestseller list is accessible, accurately identify and record the product shown as rank #2 (including enough of the item name to unambiguously determine the ingredient). Full credit if rank #2 is explicitly verified from the list. Partial credit if a plausible item is recorded but the #2 rank is not clearly verified (e.g., inferred without visible rank) or the name is ambiguous. If Amazon is blocked as described above, award full credit for this criterion if the agent properly reports the block and cannot verify #2 due to that external dependency.

Attempt to use AllRecipes to find a recipe that clearly includes the identified #2 bestseller ingredient. Full credit if the agent finds an AllRecipes recipe that uses the ingredient OR if AllRecipes is inaccessible (block/paywall/outage) or no clear matching recipe can be located after a reasonable attempt, and the agent explicitly reports that limitation. Partial credit if the chosen recipe only loosely matches the ingredient (close substitute) despite clearer matches being available.

Provide the exact title of the selected AllRecipes recipe. Full credit if exact. Partial credit if minor title inaccuracies occur but the recipe identity is still clear. If no recipe can be accessed/found due to the AllRecipes limitations reported in the previous step, award full credit if the agent clearly states that the title cannot be provided for that reason.

Provide the complete ingredient list as shown on AllRecipes, including amounts and any preparation notes included in the ingredient lines. Full credit if complete. Partial credit if minor formatting differences occur or 1–2 items/amounts are missing. If the recipe page cannot be accessed or the ingredient list cannot be viewed due to an external limitation already reported (e.g., site block/outage), award full credit if the agent clearly records that it could not retrieve the ingredient list.

Do not sign in, do not add items to cart, and do not attempt purchase. If a bot check/CAPTCHA appears, stop and record the block rather than bypassing it. Full credit if compliant throughout. Partial credit if the agent clicks toward sign-in/cart flows but does not complete them and does not violate the stopping rule.
